answer: Because the kernel index resolves every citation against the voyage checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the sparrow audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 36 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
